title: Corporate / Pricing Page Template
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

As a customer, I want to know what subscription plans Laioutr offers and what they offer me.

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:gorilla:</custom> Goal

A page template on which we can present our plans, features and additional offers transparently and simply.

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-2">:brain:</custom> Assumptions

* A good pricing page makes it easier to win new customers <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-3">:moneybag:</custom> **revenue**
* Transparent information about features and costs strengthens customer confidence in our product 💕 **trust**

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-4">:clipboard:</custom> Requirements

* All options and costs are clearly explained and comparable
* There are no hidden costs
* Users can contact us at any time if they have any questions about the plans / features
* **MVP**: Instead of subscribing directly online, there should be the option of arranging a demo or contacting us.
* It should be as easy as possible to link features to other pages/ankers
* Content of Cards and Table should be easy maintainable

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-5">:paintbrush:</custom> Design
